Name: Foraging Tracker Profession - Incorrect Arrow Position when Zoomed Fix
Author: mydan123
Description:
[size=5]Overview
[/size]Fixes a bug with the Level 10 Foraging "Tracker" profession. This profession makes arrows appear at the edges of your screen to point to any off-screen forageables, artifact spots, and panning spots. When you change your "Zoom" level and "UI Scale" level so that they don't match, these arrows will appear in the wrong position - finding those artifact spots becomes needlessly tricky, especially when they're hiding behind a tree!

This mod fixes that bug, so you never have to worry about losing track of artifact spots again.

You can see the bug report for the issue fixed by this mod at the following link:
[url=https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/foraging-tracker-profession-arrows-appear-in-wrong-positions-when-ui-scale-and-zoom-level-dont-match.21479/]Windows - Foraging "Tracker" Profession - Arrows appear in wrong positions when UI Scale and Zoom Level don't match | Stardew Valley Forums[/url]

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Install_SMAPI]Install SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*]Download the mod and unzip it into [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Find_your_game_folder]the Mods folder of your Stardew Valley installation[/url]﻿
[*]Run the game via SMAPI
[/list]
[size=5]Other notes[/size]
[list]
[*]The mod does not modify your save file, so you can install and uninstall it at any time
[*]In order to prevent the game's default tracker arrows from showing up, the mod internally switches the player's Tracker profession to a different custom value while the game is running. This means it will not be compatible with other mods that use the Tracker profession. Additionally, you won't see "Tracker" when mousing over level ten foraging in the "Skills" menu.
[/list]
[size=5]See also[/size][list]
[*][url=https://github.com/busisd/TrackerZoomFix/tree/mainline]The mod's source code[/url]﻿
[/list]
